phase_constraint_vs_user_constraint.V137: Neither source arm eligible => selected null/no private forward. This prospective phase commitment remains unchanged.
phase_constraint_vs_user_constraint.user: No explicit source-pass gate before all evaluation appears in the provided user requests; that gate was self-imposed for source-only model selection.
phase_constraint_vs_user_constraint.separate_later_scope: A new frozen measurement question may be defined prospectively without rewriting V137 results. Existing evaluation authorization should be assessed in context; this review requests no user permission and grants no private access.

preserve_strict_gate.benefit: Keeps current evaluation untouched until an eligible source model exists and minimizes adaptive private feedback.
preserve_strict_gate.limit: If all source models fail, it leaves actual transfer unmeasured and cannot show whether source-gate tradeoffs correspond to application performance.

frozen_benchmark_only.benefit: Measures the transfer gap of fixed successful and failed source controls, directly answering the comparison goal.
frozen_benchmark_only.limit: Does not select a model, certify deployment or excuse source failures. Repeated private-informed development would make this panel an adaptive validation set, not an untouched final test.

adaptive_private_search.reason: Changing model/threshold/crop/GT mapping or choosing the private winner would contradict the declared no-private-fit/no-private-selection scope.

prospective_controls: Create a separate immutable benchmark-only policy before reading any current223 body; leave all V137 policy/results unchanged.

List the complete comparator panel by scientific role and freeze exact weight, architecture, preprocessing, initializer/q8/L, decoder, availability and threshold bindings before access; report every listed model, including failed source controls.

Use saved outputs where available and preserve the user saved-output request. If a new fixed evaluation forward is within existing authorization, seal each complete input-only prediction packet before opening labels or reference coordinates.

Use the same original evaluation cohort and fixed annotation/channel correspondence; preserve noquery/OOB/missing predictions as U with full known D/E recall denominators. Keep self occlusion, external occlusion, uncertain labels and positional error distinct.
Predeclare material/shape and occlusion strata, metrics, any uncertainty calculations and deterministic qualitative case rules. Do not show only the winner, favorable subsets or hand-picked crops.
Report source eligibility/pass counts beside all evaluation results. selected_model remains null and deployment/adoption remains false; private scores never relax a source gate or set a threshold.

Do not feed private labels, errors, cases or rankings into the next model/crop/synthetic-curriculum/hyperparameter choice under a claimed source-only selection protocol. If repeated private-guided iteration is desired, declare it validation and obtain a separate final holdout.
After the fixed panel, any actual adoption still requires the separately declared acceptance process; benchmark-only comparison does not turn a source-ineligible model into an accepted candidate.
failure_cherry_picking_risks: Selecting comparator membership after seeing current scores
Reporting only the best failed model or the favorable material/error subgroup
Dropping U/bad-q cases or using GT-centered recrops to improve reported metrics
Changing gate relevance or the next method because the private winner suggests it, while claiming private-independent selection
Calling repeated private-informed comparisons a fresh untouched test
no_actions_taken: No private/current223/V112 image, label, score or metadata body read
